verdict.rationale: The three.js source is publicly hosted on GitHub and can be cloned directly. A hands-on registry probe verified the package is MIT-licensed, which is an open license that permits reading and reuse of the source. Missing for 10: a first-party LICENSE file or license statement quoted from the repository itself; the license evidence comes from the npm registry probe rather than the repo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
